const source = $json;
const stripHtml = (value = '') => String(value)
  .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ')
  .replace(/ /g, ' ')
  .replace(/&/g, '&')
  .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
  .trim();

return {
  json: {
    woocommerce_product_id: source.id,
    expected_variation_ids: Array.isArray(source.variations) ? source.variations : [],
    product_type: source.type || 'simple',
    name: source.name || 'Producto sin nombre',
    slug: source.slug || '',
    status: source.status || 'publish',
    permalink: source.permalink || '',
    sku: source.sku || '',
    price: source.price || '',
    regular_price: source.regular_price || '',
    sale_price: source.sale_price || '',
    on_sale: Boolean(source.on_sale),
    purchasable: Boolean(source.purchasable),
    stock_status: source.stock_status || 'unknown',
    stock_quantity: source.stock_quantity ?? '',
    image_url: source.images?.[0]?.src || '',
    categories: source.categories || [],
    tags: source.tags || [],
    attributes: source.attributes || [],
    short_description: stripHtml(source.short_description).slice(0, 1500),
    description: stripHtml(source.description).slice(0, 20000),
    source_modified_at: source.date_modified_gmt || source.date_modified || ''
  }
};
